observations: I read assets/panels/08-4.png. Meera (left), Ananya (centre) and Ravi (right) stand in front of the clinic entrance with its teal awning, glass doors, planters and warm morning light. It is full colour with no vignette, so it clearly returns to the present after 08-2/08-3.

Meera matches main-cast (side braid with teal tie, blue patterned kurta, white churidar, navy flats). She holds the staff phone, back toward the reader, in her right hand (the bangle wrist) at her side, and her left hand is empty. This matches production.

Ananya matches her sheet (low bun, stethoscope, white coat over teal kurta, leggings, sandals) and her hands are clasped in front. Small pale marks show on both wrists. They are most likely the kurta cuffs, but they could read as bandages at 200%. This is minor and not raised as an issue.
Ravi raises his right hand in a small wave, and his left hand, with the watch, hangs empty at his side, matching production. The bag is on his right shoulder, matching the main-cast sheet and 07-4.
There is a clear sky band at the top and an empty pavement band at the bottom for the product label and the closing caption. There is no text or signage in the art.
